title: The surviving mutant is a real gap: an NFD-encoded known candidate name is not matched, so a second person in the quote is missed
evidence: 31603620, always-yes verifier, 3 runs. Mutating knownN to skip fold() on the known set (new Set([...known].map(k => k.toLowerCase()))) survives all 48 speakers-grounded tests and ships a wrong multi-name quote: turns a0 spk:0 (NFD) 'Rashi, ask josé about the rules please.' / a1 spk:1 'Yes, happy to explain the process here.' / a2 spk:3 'Thanks Rashi, that was very clear.' / a3 spk:4 (NFD) 'Hello, my name is José Rao and I moderate.'; proposals {spk:1,Rashi,called-on},{spk:1,Rashi,thanks},{spk:4,José Rao (NFD),self-intro} ships spk:1=Rashi (resolved includes spk:1). On HEAD (fold present) the same fixture abstains. Reachable whenever the transcript or the model's name is decomposed, because the span is folded to NFC but the known set is not. The Devanagari NFD/ZWJ/ZWNJ/romanized-mix attacks (A1-A8, B1-B3) are all refused on HEAD.
fix_direction: Add the fixture above as a regression test in speakers-grounded.test.ts (D = s.normalize('NFD'); span, quote and José Rao name all NFD, expect resolved to NOT contain spk:1); it kills the mutant.
